skill.summary: Plan and execute a product launch for a solopreneur business. Use when launching a new product, feature, service, or major update. Covers pre-launch strategy...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the product-launch skill for solopreneurs.
- Provides a step-by-step playbook covering pre-launch strategy, content creation, building anticipation, launch day execution, post-launch momentum, and measuring success.
- Includes tactical checklists, content planning, email sequences, and metrics tracking.
- Designed to trigger on common product launch phrases and queries.
